memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity
  - Status: Weight 92 kg, waist 102 cm (>90 cm cut-off).
  - Plan: Start orlistat 120 mg with each main meal; advise reduced calorie diet, 150 min/week walk; re‑check weight and waist in 8 weeks.
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Episodes of positional vertigo lasting <1 min, Dix‑Hallpike pending.
  - Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg twice daily; meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute vertigo; schedule Dix‑Hallpike and audiometry.
- Vitamin D deficiency
  - Status: Serum 25‑OH‑D 18 ng/mL (deficient).
  - Plan: Cholecalciferol 60 000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU daily; re‑check level after 3 months.
Due: Next HbA1c check 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Dix‑Hallpike test: Positive for right posterior canal BPPV. Vertigo and torsional nystagmus provoked, lasting <1 minute. No abnormal auditory findings.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Pure tone audiometry: Bilateral mild high‑frequency hearing loss. Thresholds 25‑30 dB at 4‑8 kHz, speech discrimination >90% bilaterally. No conductive component.
